title: Sar peeto karo maatam barpa
body:
Sar peeto karo maatam barpa jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
hai koun e makaa'n me shor o buka jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaisa sitam masjid me hua, sajde me hue zaqmi moula
jibreel amee'n dete hai sada, jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Be jurm o qata ye zulm kiya, kya qoob diya neki ka sila
sajde me namaazi ko maara, jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zaqmm laga sar par gehra, aur zard hua saara chehra
sar thaame tadapte hai moula, jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne yahi ro ro ke kaha, gar jald na aayenge baba
nikloongi mai ghar se be parda, jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
taaboot se lipti hai zainab, rukhsat ki ghadi hai haaye ghazab
uth'ta hai janaza hyder ka, jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hai gham me ali ke haal bura, shabbir bayaa'n ho kaise bhala
ho lab pa musalsal waawaila, jaate hai jahaa'n se haaye Ali
